steps.claim: Suppose that for every i there are φ arbitrarily close to δ_i with ‖charpoly(T(φ))(1)‖ < 1.
Rewrite charpoly(M)(1) as det(1 − M) and the condition as membership in the open unit ball.

For each i ≤ |n|: ‖det(1 − y^i A)‖ < 1. Otherwise the closed-ball complement would be a neighbourhood of δ_i (T continuous) on which ‖det(1 − T(φ))‖ ≥ 1, using det(1 − y^iA) = ∏ over the eigenvalues (det_aeval_neg_eq_prod_roots).
